data.name: SetHotkeysHelp
data.value: Click a box and press the keys to set a shortcut (Backspace / Delete clears it). Combine the key with Ctrl, Alt, or Win (F13–F24 can be used alone). While a box is selected, all PresenterTools shortcuts are paused. Keys you assign can no longer be used in other apps.

data.name: SetResetHotkeysToolTip

data.name: SetDiameterToolTip

data.name: SetCursorHelp
data.value: Ring: uses opacity, diameter, and line width. Filled circle: uses fill opacity and diameter. Changes are shown on the ring right away (move the mouse over this window to check; click Apply or OK to keep them). px is at 100% display scaling. For Teams sharing or projectors, a diameter of about 60–100 is easy to see.

data.name: SetShowButtonLabel
data.value: Show "Left click" / "Right click" near the click position (at least 0.8 s)

data.name: SetShowWhileHeld
data.value: Show a mark at the cursor while a button is held down (for explaining drags)

data.name: SetClickHelp
data.value: A left click is shown as a solid circle and a right click as a dashed diamond. The mark for a held button appears only after the button is held for 0.2 seconds or more (so that normal clicks do not flicker). The click itself still goes to the app. Changes are shown right away (click an empty area of this window to check; click Apply or OK to keep them).

data.name: SetLaserEnable
data.value: Use Laser (Enabled; start drawing with the drawing key or mouse button)

data.name: SetTriggerToggle
data.value: Press to start drawing, press again to stop

data.name: SetLaserHelp
data.value: Color, line width, and trail time are shown in the try-it box right away (click Apply or OK to keep them). With "Press to start drawing, press again to stop", press the drawing key (or mouse button) once to draw, and press it again or press Esc to finish (Esc is also passed to the app in front). A side button you assign can no longer be used for Back / Forward in browsers. If a mouse utility maps the button to a key operation, the button cannot be detected (map it to F13–F24 or similar in the utility and set that key as a shortcut).

data.name: SetMagHelp
data.value: The magnifier window is placed automatically where it does not cover the area around the cursor, and follows the cursor. The screen is captured only while it is ON (about 30 fps).

data.name: SetKeyWarning
data.value: While ON, everything you type is shown on the screen, including passwords. Key Display is always OFF at startup. Turn it OFF before you type passwords or anything you do not want to show.
